reason: Provider Hub is a local external-service integration that unifies API-key and official-account model providers behind an OpenAI-compatible relay with routing, failover, model discovery, and usage logging.

summaries.zh: Provider Hub 将 API Key 渠道和官方账号模型服务统一到本地兼容 OpenAI 的中继中，并提供模型发现、路由故障切换与请求日志。
summaries.en: Provider Hub unifies API-key and official-account model services behind a local OpenAI-compatible relay with model discovery, routing failover, and request logging.

capabilities: Aggregates and routes requests to configured API-compatible model providers
Manages provider API keys and official-account OAuth credentials through DSH credentials
Downloads, verifies, starts, and stops a locally managed account-service sidecar
Exposes authenticated local OpenAI-compatible relay endpoints
Collects request, token, performance, failover, and cost logs
